items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Billy Kyle fed that band, and I played against them with Charlie Barnet

ctx.x: Before me, the band was comprised of impeccable musicians, Buster Bailey's thoroughly -- because Charlie Shavers wrote a book that was pretty rough to play, and they played impeccably. Every member. By the same token, Billy Kyle fed that band, and I played against them with Charlie Barnet, doing the Worlds Fair in '39, and
they almost cut us a brand new one, and I had never seen their drummer.
